moment:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit only Pelageya's anatomical RIGHT forearm/hand on the viewer LEFT and the small immediately adjacent brick area. Current image makes her right hand grasp the money-bag neck beside the player's hand. Story requires that she DOES NOT TOUCH the bag before the explanation.

Move Pelageya's RIGHT hand AWAY from the bag and lay that hand flat/palm-down on the cold oven bricks BETWEEN the full bag and her torso, clearly separate from the bag. Give an unmistakable visible narrow strip of bare brick/air gap between EVERY part of her hand and the bag: no fingertip, thumb or sleeve touching the bag's side or neck. Her right forearm should come from her right coat cuff and rest naturally on bricks, with sensible bent elbow; all five fingers belong to that one hand, some may overlap naturally. The existing player's hand remains the ONLY hand touching/gripping the tied bag neck, lowering it onto bricks. Bag remains full, in same place/shape/material, bottom supported on bricks. Pelageya's LEFT hand (viewer right) stays unchanged on oven bricks. Keep the two people's hands distinct and readable, no new hand.

Preserve all other content: exactly the same Pelageya face/gaze, faded blue headscarf, hair, clothing, proportions, coat color, restrained expression; same player dark sleeve, full bag, ruined brick oven, basket/bread, gray dawn/sky, apple trees/road/forest, two background company companions/outfits and all their gear. Do not add Klim, a body, white handkerchief, bandage, coins, letter, new people, structures, emblems, writing or glow. No reframing, brightening, redrawing faces, photography or style change. Same restrained matte graphic-novel ink/wash and opaque 1536x1024 canvas. Only the woman's RIGHT hand/forearm needs a new pose and the adjacent exposed brick restored.
